name: 10pcs Beauty Glazed Nose Pore Strips Blackhead Remover 3gm
description:
High-quality pore cleaner: Our new pore cleaner is unique in that it can dredge pores by removing grease, dirt, and blackheads, and its efficacy is twice that of leading pore cleaners. Particular skin care-one-step solution: wash the face, apply it to the wet nose, and wait 10 to 15 minutes. Instant results! 
High-quality ingredients: These strips are made of pure, precise-grade materials, including water, an appropriate amount of titanium dioxide, and other high-quality ingredients. These are hypoallergenic and suitable for all skin types. 
NET WT: 2g*10 
Type: Wrapped Mask 
Feature: Blackhead removal,oil-control
